findings.evidence: Basic.lean:10 `public import EpsilonEridani.Mathematics.LinearAlgebra.BilinearForm.Reflection`; Reflection.lean:49-117 holds `reflection`, `reflection_apply_self`, `reflection_reflection_apply`, `det_reflection` in `LinearMap.BilinForm` over a general field. The namespace collision is already visible at Basic.lean:120, where the pre-existing `Kinematics.Bilin.apply_sub_self` must be fully qualified because the new `Tensors.Bilin` shadows it.
findings.fix: Move the three lemmas into `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Reflection.lean`, namespace `LinearMap.BilinForm`, over its general `{K V} [Field K]` variables; in `reflection_sub_apply_left` replace the ℝ-only `Kinematics.Bilin.apply_sub_self` by Mathlib's `LinearMap.BilinForm.IsSymm.polarization` (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Properties.lean:138), which needs no division by 2. Then delete the `namespace Bilin … end Bilin` block at Basic.lean:100-138 and call the lemmas as `g.det_reflection_comp_reflection` / `g.reflection_sub_apply_left` from Spectators.lean:85,109,110,112.
findings.issue: `Bilin.det_reflection_comp_reflection` (105), `Bilin.reflection_sub_apply_left` (116) and `Bilin.reflection_sub_apply_right` (132) contain nothing DIS-specific and nothing ℝ-specific: they are generic facts about `LinearMap.BilinForm.reflection`, whose located API already lives in `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/Reflection.lean` (`reflection_apply`, `reflection_apply_self`, `reflection_apply_of_orthogonal`, `reflection_reflection_apply`, `det_reflection`), a public import of this file. Putting them in a second, shadowing `Tensors.Bilin` namespace gives the reflection object two parallel homes, so a later user searching `LinearMap.BilinForm` will not find them and will reprove them.

summary: The prior duplication findings are resolved and the shared extractions (apply_smul_sqrt_div_self, flip_add_smul_of_isSymm_of_isAlt, apply_eq_of_spectatorPair) are genuine reuse. Remaining: three field-general bilinear-form reflection lemmas are added in a new DIS-local `Tensors.Bilin` namespace instead of the located `LinearMap.BilinForm` reflection module, splitting that API in two.
